title: Collinear stations cannot resolve the mirror pair
description: All four stations lie exactly on y = 500 m. Reflection across that line leaves every propagation delay unchanged, so a call at (900, 180) is timing-indistinguishable from one at (900, 820). The service must return both disconnected feasible regions and must not report one coordinate. Counting is unaffected: each call is still one event.

expected.note: every event must expose at least two feasible regions
